capabilities: Apply colored highlights using =={color}text== syntax via context menu or per-color commands
Change or remove existing highlights from a right-click menu
Customize color palettes, slugs, hex values, and per-color hotkeys in settings
Switch between four highlight visual styles (solid, lowlight, underlined, rounded)
Convert existing <mark> highlights to the token format progressively
extras: Mobile support is described as in beta. Exporting to external markdown renderers may show the {color} token as literal text; automatic token stripping on export is listed as a future option. Annotations, a highlights sidebar, and drag-to-reorder colors are explicitly out of scope. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or newer.
intentEvidence: swapping the output format for native ==text==
motivation: The author wanted multi-color highlights that don't break markdown's natural flow, after finding that HTML mark-based plugins lose inline formatting and hurt note portability.
problem: HTML <mark>-based highlight plugins break inline markdown inside highlights (bold, wikilinks render as raw text) and bake hex colors into the note text.

relations.evidence: inspired by Chetachi's Highlightr and Highlightr+
inspired by Chetachi's Highlightr and Highlightr+

summary: Multi-color highlight plugin that adds color slugs to Obsidian's native ==text== syntax, keeping inline markdown working inside highlights.
